prompt: Read two integers and print their sum. Pure I/O warm-up.
Decide whether a given integer is even or odd, printing a fixed word for each case.
Given n integers, print the largest one and how many times it occurs.
Reverse a given lowercase string.
Count vowels in a lowercase string.
Sum of decimal digits of a possibly very large non-negative integer given as a string (up to 10^5 digits).
Given n daily temperatures, count days where the temperature strictly increased compared to the previous day.
Count integers in [1, n] divisible by a or b (inclusion-exclusion with two small divisors).
Check whether a lowercase string is a palindrome.
Find the second largest DISTINCT value in an array, or report that it does not exist.
A permutation of 1..n has exactly one number removed; find it from the remaining n-1 numbers.
Convert a binary string (up to 60 bits) to its decimal value.
Find the most frequent character in a string; break ties by alphabetical order.
A person climbs stairs taking steps of size 1 or k; minimum number of steps to reach exactly step n.
Rotate an array right by k positions (k can exceed n) and print the result.
Given an array and target, output the 1-based indices of the unique pair summing to the target (guaranteed exactly one solution), smaller index first. Classic hash-map lookup.
Check whether a bracket sequence of ()[]{} is balanced. Classic stack.
Decide whether two lowercase strings are anagrams of each other.
Static array, q range-sum queries [l, r]. Classic prefix sums; n, q up to 2*10^4.
Compute the GCD of n integers.
From a sorted array, print distinct values in order (deduplicate in one pass).
Sum both diagonals of an n x n matrix without double-counting the center.
One buy and one sell (buy before sell) to maximize profit over n daily prices; print max profit (0 if never profitable). Classic single-pass min-tracking.
Find the element occurring more than n/2 times (guaranteed to exist).
Move all zeroes of an array to the end keeping relative order of nonzero elements; print the array.
Position (1-based) of the first character that appears exactly once in a string, or -1.
Merge two sorted arrays into one sorted sequence in O(n+m).
Count ways to climb n steps taking 1 or 2 at a time, modulo 10^9+7. Intro DP / Fibonacci.
Given an array and q queries, each asking for the minimum in a prefix [1, r]; precompute prefix minima.
Given n intervals, find the maximum number of non-overlapping intervals (classic activity selection, sort by right endpoint).
Does the array contain two equal elements at distance at most k? Classic window + hash set.
Longest common prefix of n strings (print it, or an empty-marker word if none).
Maximum subarray sum (Kadane). Values can be negative; n up to 2*10^4.
For each of q values, find the position where it would be inserted in a sorted array to keep order (lower bound), 1-based.
Count primes up to n (n up to 10^6). Sieve of Eratosthenes.
Every value appears exactly twice except one which appears once; find it. XOR trick.
Reverse the order of words in a sentence, normalizing runs of spaces to single spaces.
Print row n of Pascal's triangle modulo 10^9+7 (n up to 10^5); iterative binomial with modular inverse.
Maximum sum over all contiguous windows of fixed length k.
For each index print the product of all other elements modulo 10^9+7 (no division; prefix/suffix products).
Count triplets (i<j<k) whose values sum to exactly t. Sort + two pointers; n up to 2000.
Length of the longest substring without repeating characters. Classic variable window.
Given n words, count how many distinct anagram groups they form, and the size of the largest group.
Minimum number of coins of given denominations to make amount X (or -1); unbounded coins, X up to 10^5.
Check if an array strictly increases then strictly decreases (a mountain), with both parts non-empty.
Count connected components of land cells (4-directional) in a grid of land/water. Classic flood fill.
Shortest path length in a grid maze from start to exit through open cells, 4-directional; -1 if unreachable.
Merge n possibly-overlapping intervals and print the total covered length and the number of merged blocks.
Choose the maximum saw height H so that cutting every tree above H yields at least W total wood. Binary search on the answer; heights up to 10^9.
Length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence, n up to 2*10^4 (patience/binary-search DP).
Maximum sum of non-adjacent elements in a line of houses. Classic take/skip DP.
Given course prerequisites as a directed graph, determine whether all courses can be finished (cycle detection via Kahn's algorithm); print the number of courses in a valid order or -1.
Find the k-th smallest element of a large array (n up to 2*10^4).
Count subarrays with sum exactly k (values may be negative). Prefix-sum + hash map of counts.
Multi-source BFS on a grid: infected cells spread to adjacent healthy cells each minute; time until all are infected or -1.
0/1 knapsack: n up to 100 items, capacity up to 10^4; maximize total value.
Levenshtein edit distance between two strings of length up to 2000.
n people, m friendship pairs; print the number of friend groups and the size of the largest. DSU.
For each day, how many days until a strictly warmer temperature (0 if never). Monotonic stack; n up to 2*10^4.
Process a stream of n numbers; after each insertion print the current median (two-heap technique). Use integer-friendly median definition: for even counts print the smaller middle.
Run-length encode a string, but only keep the encoding if strictly shorter than the original; print whichever wins.
Can the array be split into two subsets with equal sums? Bitset/boolean subset-sum DP; total sum up to 2*10^4.
Cheapest path between two cities in a weighted undirected graph (n, m up to 2*10^4, weights up to 10^9). Dijkstra with heap.
Longest palindromic substring of a string up to length 2000 (expand-around-center); if several, output the leftmost.
Can a string be segmented into dictionary words (dictionary of up to 1000 words)? Classic word-break DP.
Shortest substring of s containing every character of t with multiplicity; print its length (or -1). Classic minimum window.
Count inversions in an array of up to 2*10^4 elements (merge-sort counting).
Count paths from top-left to bottom-right moving only right/down, avoiding blocked cells, modulo 10^9+7; grid up to 300x300.
Is the given undirected graph bipartite? BFS 2-coloring; print a fixed word for each case.
Classic trapped rainwater between bars; n up to 2*10^4.
Print the lexicographically smallest topological order of a DAG (or -1 if cyclic). Kahn with a min-heap.
Longest common subsequence length of two strings up to 3000 chars each.
Split an array into k contiguous parts minimizing the maximum part sum. Binary search on answer + greedy check.
Given a sorted array, a value x and k, output the k values closest to x (ties prefer smaller); two-pointer shrink.
Cheapest route between two airports using at most k intermediate stops (Bellman-Ford style relaxation rounds).
Longest strictly increasing path in a matrix moving 4-directionally (memoized DFS or DP over cells sorted by value); n*m up to 10^5 cells, values up to 10^9.
For every window of length k print the number of distinct values; n up to 2*10^4.
Weighted interval scheduling: n jobs with start/end/profit, maximize total profit of non-overlapping jobs; n up to 2*10^4.
Count ways to form amount X from given coin denominations (order irrelevant), modulo 10^9+7; X up to 10^5.
Grid where entering a cell costs 0 or 1 (breaking a wall); minimum total cost path corner to corner via 0-1 BFS (deque).
Preprocess a string so q query words can each be tested for being a subsequence; next-occurrence table.
Total weight of a minimum spanning tree (or -1 if disconnected); Kruskal with DSU, m up to 2*10^4.
Simulate an LRU cache of capacity c over n get/put operations, printing results of gets; use ordered structure for O(1) ops.
Maximum product over all contiguous subarrays, tracking running min/max because negatives flip signs; values in [-9, 9] and n up to 1000 so exact big-integer products stay fast in Python.
2D prefix sums: q rectangle-sum queries on an n x m grid (n*m up to 10^5, q up to 10^4).
Given sorted fence-post positions, binary search the k-th smallest pairwise gap; count pairs with gap <= mid via two pointers.
Count how many times the digit 1 appears writing all numbers from 1 to N (N up to 10^15); digit DP or positional counting.
Diameter (longest path, in edges) of an unweighted tree with up to 2*10^4 nodes; double BFS.

Two optimal players alternately take 1-3 stones with given per-pile scoring twist: from a sequence of n valued stones taken from the front, maximize score difference; print who wins (or the first player's max score difference). n up to 10^5.
Longest subsequence forming an arithmetic progression with a FIXED given common difference d; hash-map DP, n up to 2*10^4.
Repeatedly join ropes; each join costs the sum of the two lengths; minimize total cost (Huffman-style min-heap), n up to 2*10^4.
Count triples of stick lengths that can form a non-degenerate triangle; sort + two pointers, n up to 5000.
Two lines forming the container holding the most water (classic two-pointer proof); n up to 2*10^4.
Evaluate an arithmetic expression with + - * / (integer division toward zero), parentheses and spaces; length up to 10^5.
Assign n workers (n <= 18) to n tasks with cost matrix, minimizing total cost; bitmask DP over subsets.
Count (possibly overlapping) occurrences of pattern P in text T using prefix-function/KMP; lengths up to 10^5.
Maximum of every window of length k via monotonic deque; n up to 2*10^4.
Count nodes whose removal disconnects the graph (articulation points) in a connected undirected graph; n, m up to 2*10^4.
Answer q lowest-common-ancestor queries on a rooted tree via binary lifting; n, q up to 2*10^4.
Minimum jumps to reach the last index where each cell gives max jump length (jump game); n up to 2*10^4, O(n) greedy.
Compute the n-th term of a linear recurrence f(n)=a*f(n-1)+b*f(n-2) modulo 10^9+7 with n up to 10^18; matrix power.
